en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a wooded park scene at Schloss Lockwitz. In the foreground is a large tree encircled by a round bench. To the left stands a wooden gymnastic structure with a tall ladder and hanging rings. The background is filled with trees and foliage, giving the impression of a quiet park area on the castle grounds. Caption text is printed in red at the bottom.
